author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
It's time to answer another round of questions from Tested members, this time from doriWyo, Spasmodiclly and V.callly (whom we thank for their support)! Adam reflects on how comedy and comic relief were used on MythBusters, shares essential advice and practical techniques for feeling comfortable on camera, and dives into the engineering realities behind retractable lightsabers. Did you think Adam was himself or a persona on the show?

Have a question for Adam? Tested members can submit questions for upcoming Q&A livestreams. Join our community to participate! https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiDJtJKMICpb9B1qf7qjEOA/join
